prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency in Kansas City — the right agency depends on what you need (brand strategy, digital/paid, B2B lead gen, creative, ecommerce, tech integrations), your budget, timeline and company size.

If you tell me a few quick details I can give a tailored short list, but here are a few general pointers plus two well-known Kansas City agencies to consider:

- How to pick the “best” for you
  - Primary goal: brand awareness, lead generation, ecommerce growth, product launches, etc.
  - Services needed: full-service creative + tech, performance marketing (PPC/paid social), SEO/content, PR, or design/branding.
  - Budget & timeline: agencies vary widely in minimum retainer and project speed.
  - Industry experience: agencies with relevant vertical experience (healthcare, finance, B2B, retail) will ramp faster.
  - Size fit: big network shops for enterprise needs; boutiques for hands-on strategy and lower cost.

- Two widely recognized KC agencies (good starting points)
  - VML (now part of VMLY&R): a global, full-service digital and creative agency founded in Kansas City — strong on integrated campaigns, technology and enterprise clients.
  - Barkley: large independent creative agency based in KC — known for strong creative/branding and integrated campaigns for national brands.

If you want, tell me:
- What type of marketing help you need
- Your industry
- Approximate monthly/annual budget
- Company size (startup, SMB, enterprise)

I’ll return a short, prioritized list of KC agencies (with why each might be a good fit) and next steps for contacting them.
